title: The Burning Oath Revisited
author: Yara Joubert
blurb: Ada Crane, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
